'''Grotto Werribee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] junior [[Traffic controller/Legends|traffic controller]] for an interstellar shipping corporation.<ref name="CCG" /> At some point by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> he left that job and eventually worked as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]].<ref name="CCG" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], while on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he attended the annual [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] stands. There, he spectated and cheered as the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] finished the race's first lap out of three.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> 

Werribee bragged that there was nothing about [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] procedure unknown to him. He had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin with symmetrical black markings across his face.<ref name="CCG" /> While at the Grand Arena, he wore a gray [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]], a cream jacket, and a gray cap.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grotto Werribee first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The Grand Arena scenes, where Werribee was portrayed by an uncredited extra, were filmed on [[August 4]], [[1997]], in [[Wikipedia:Tunisia|Tunisia]].<ref name="It'sLikeWarNow">{{SW|url=video/it-s-like-war-now|series=Making Episode I Webdocs|text=Part 9: It's Like War Now}}</ref> The character was first named with the [[2001]] ''[[Coruscant Limited]]'' expansion to [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
